artworks.title: The Crowning with Thorns
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group scene featuring individuals in historical garments. The image depicts a variety of figures, some seated and others standing, possibly soldiers with spears and helmets, surrounding a central action. The scene is set in an architectural space with pillars seen in the background, and two individuals are silhouetted on a balcony observing the scene. The texture consists of fine lines, providing depth and shading to the characters and environment.

artworks.title: The Ecce Homo
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large crowd and an event in front of an architectural structure. The drawing shows numerous figures in an architectural space, likely a square or courtyard, with a prominent arched building in the background that features large columns and a central doorway. Many figures hold flags or banners, indicating an organized event or public gathering. In the foreground, a tall wooden cross is being uplifted by one individual, surrounded by several other figures in various gestures. The architectural elements and clothing detail suggest a historical or allegorical theme. The engraving technique used highlights intricate linework and texture. Text at the bottom adds context to the visual scene.

artworks.title: The Carrying of the Cross
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.6 × 21.5 cm (4 9/16 × 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded scene at a city gate. The composition is full of intricately detailed figures, both mounted and on foot, engaged in a bustling activity. In the foreground, a structure with an archway labeled "S PORT" serves as an entry point, through which a stream of soldiers and individuals carrying large spears or pike-like weapons are moving. Several figures are mounted on horseback. The background shows a rugged landscape with more people gathered along the ridges in groups, as well as a complex of distant city architecture with towers and domes visible above the throng. A small dog is depicted in the lower center of the image. The drawing features strong linework that enhances the texture of both the figures and the landscape. The inscription below the scene adds a textual element.

artworks.title: The Nailing to the Cross
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with various figures and a crowd of onlookers. The drawing depicts a chaotic scene with soldiers and observers gathered in different parts of the composition. The scene is detailed with numerous figures on foot and horseback, some bearing weapons. The onlookers form a packed audience, seemingly watching or involved in the events taking place. The linework is intricate, capturing the scene’s dynamism and the individual details of clothing, weaponry, and natural surroundings. The sky is rendered with a few wisps of clouds, emphasizing the open-air setting and adding a sense of movement to the scene.

artworks.title: Pantalone
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.7 × 14.8 cm (8 9/16 × 5 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length profile of a person who is depicted in a bent-forward position. The figure's facial features are exaggerated with a long, pointed nose and a bushy beard. They wear a cap on their head and are dressed in a long coat and tight-fitted pants. They hold something in front of their abdomen. In the background, there are buildings with arched windows and doorways, as well as a tower to the left. A crowd of smaller figures is in the square or street beyond. The background has smaller people engaged in various activities or watching something, with a sky filled with light clouds.

artworks.title: Il Capitano, or L'Innamorato
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.3 × 14.7 cm (8 3/8 × 5 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man with long, wavy hair flowing from under a wide-brimmed hat. He has a prominent mustache and is wearing a period-style suit with padded shoulders, intricate sleeves, and a snug collar. His attire also includes knee-length pants, pointed shoes, and one glove. He is holding an object in his gloved hand and stands upright with a slightly tilted head. In the background, there is a cityscape with tall buildings, an open square filled with a crowd, and detailed architecture featuring windows and arches.

artworks.title: Zanni
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.5 × 14.6 cm (8 7/16 × 5 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing, wearing a wide-brimmed hat with two feathers. They have a stern expression with facial hair, holding a sword pointed downward. The background is a town with traditional European buildings, featuring balconies and arched windows. In the midground, small groups of people are engaged in conversation.

artworks.title: Donato Dell' Antella
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.3 × 14.8 cm (7 5/8 × 5 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man from the shoulders up. He is facing forward with his head turned slightly to the left. The man has a serious expression, a high forehead, a long nose, and a long beard. He has little hair on the top of his head, a receded hairline, but hair on the sides. He is dressed in what appears to be a high-collared robe. Surrounding the portrait is an ornate frame with intricate carvings including swirls, floral motifs, and a central shell at the top. There is a detailed coat of arms at the bottom of the frame. The background features a decorative, classical architectural design with elements commonly found in ornate print or etching artwork.

artworks.title: The Catafalque of the Emperor Mathias
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.3 × 20.9 cm (11 1/8 × 8 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior space. The drawing depicts a grand interior scene featuring a large, vaulted hall adorned with architectural details and decorative elements. A pyramid-like structure composed of light sources or candles is positioned at the center back of the room. The room is lined with columns and drapery, and the ceiling is coffered. On the walls, there are sculpted figures and framed artworks. The composition includes figures gathered, with the title at the bottom referring to the death of Emperor Matthias.

artworks.title: The Fair at Impruneta
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 43.1 × 67.5 cm (16 15/16 × 26 9/16 in.)

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act I
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.6 × 27.6 cm (7 11/16 × 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with tall, intricate buildings lining a street. The buildings guide the viewer's gaze towards an ornate structure in the distance. The horizon features distant architecture. The etching technique details the architectural features and figures. The color palette is a monochrome sepia tone. Close to the viewer, figures in period attire populate the scene, creating a lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act II
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.7 × 27.4 cm (7 3/4 × 10 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural composition viewed from a central perspective. The street and buildings lead towards the horizon, which is in the center. Two large, ornate buildings flank the sides, creating symmetry. In the distance, there is an arched structure on the horizon line. The artwork uses detailed line work and shading, giving it a monochromatic appearance in tones of sepia and grey. Figures are seen in a procession, adding a narrative element to the scene. The sky has linear cloud forms above the architecture.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act III
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20 × 27.9 cm (7 7/8 × 11 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural city scene. The artwork depicts a detailed cityscape with a focus on classical architecture lining a wide thoroughfare. The street extends into the distance, framed by symmetrical rows of grand buildings featuring tall, structured facades with intricate detailing, arched windows, and statuary niches. In the central part of the scene, ornate buildings and a public space suggest a gathering of individuals or a ceremonial procession. The vantage point allows the viewer to see down the street to a grand building at the end, framed by columns with a dome-like structure, indicating a terminus or significant landmark. The use of perspective draws the eye towards the vanishing point, providing depth and a sense of grandeur to the urban setting.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act IV
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20 × 27.9 cm (7 7/8 × 11 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural street view with grand buildings lining a broad street on either side. The distant horizon is marked by an ornamental structure at the center. The facades of the buildings display detailed architectural elements. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia and black. Figures in elaborate attire are gathered in the foreground, with more figures and receding buildings in the distance. The sky is lightly clouded.

artworks.title: Cosimo II de' Medici, Grand Duke of Tuscany
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20 × 13.3 cm (7 7/8 × 5 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man in an ornate oval frame. The man faces slightly to the right, having an elongated face with a mustache, short hair, a ruffled collar, and a decorated garment. Surrounding the frame are designs including a large-winged creature at the top and cherubic figures holding flags and armor. A heraldic shield with spheres is below the portrait. The background has intricate line work and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Smaralo Cornuto and Ratsa di Boio
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring stylized, anthropomorphic figures in a surreal scene. The foreground shows two large, fantastical characters: one with a long beak-like nose, a pointed hat or horn, and a dark cloak; the other with exaggerated muscular features, a billowing scarf, and a masked face with long feathers. They are depicted in motion, interacting with each other. In the midground, several smaller figures are engaged in various activities, some holding sticks or props. The background shows simple structures hinting at a village setting. The overall composition, with mysterious, masked characters, suggests a sense of carnival or theatrical performance. The lines are clear and lively, giving a dynamic feel to the scene.

artworks.title: Scaramucia and Fricasso
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two stylized figures engaged in a duel with swords. The two figures, labeled "Scaramucia" and "Fricasso," are depicted in dynamic poses with swords drawn. They wear elaborate costumes, including broad-brimmed hats with feathers. The background contains small figures and architectural elements, giving the impression of a broader scene. The style of the drawing includes fine lines and attention to theatrical costume details.

artworks.title: Scapino and Cap. Zerbino
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two full-bodied figures in theatrical costumes labeled "Scapino" and "Cap. Zerbino." "Scapino" has an elongated nose, a hat with feathers, a long coat, a striped outfit, and a sword. "Cap. Zerbino" also has an elongated nose, a feathered hat, a detailed jacket, and distinctive shoes. Both figures have expressive postures. In the background, several figures interact, with buildings and trees on each side, and a bag on the ground between them.

artworks.title: Bello Sguardo and Coviello
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two fantastical figures facing each other atop a landscape with smaller figures and buildings in the background. The drawing depicts two muscular creatures with exaggerated limbs, each brandishing a large sword and holding a cloak or cloth that billows behind them. They appear to be in motion, with dynamic poses suggesting combat or a ritualistic dance. The background features smaller human-like figures observing the scene, as well as distant architectural structures, possibly a cityscape. The title "Bello Sguardo" is inscribed below the figure on the left, and "Couiello" below the figure on the right. This artwork has a detailed pen and ink style.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act V
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.7 × 25.3 cm (8 1/8 × 9 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. The drawing depicts a city engulfed in turmoil and fire. The buildings line a broad street, and classical architecture is visible, with arches and columns. Figures are dispersed throughout the streets, depicting chaos and movement. Some figures are shown in combat, holding shields and weapons, while others appear to be fleeing or lying on the ground. The drawing is detailed, with intricate linework capturing the energy and intensity of the scene.

artworks.title: Franca Trippa and Fritellino
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two costumed figures engaging in a lively performance. The image features two characters labeled 'Franca Trippa' and 'Fritellino,' both wearing exaggerated outfits with long feathers in their hats and engaging in animated postures. The figures are drawn in a stylized manner typical of caricatures, with their features exaggerated for comedic effect. The background shows a group of buildings and several smaller figures, possibly an audience or fellow performers. The drawing suggests a vibrant and humorous depiction, capturing a theatrical or festival atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene viewed from an elevated angle, showing a bustling and chaotic crowd below. The composition is framed within an oval shape with various figures interacting in the center. A tall building with ornate details is on the left, while another building is on the right. Smaller structures in the distance give the scene depth. The background features streaky lines suggesting clouds. The image is monochromatic, using shades of brown with intricate line work and cross-hatching to show texture and shadow.

artworks.title: Piazza SS. Annunziata, Florence
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a town square from an elevated perspective. A figure in period clothing leans on a cane while overlooking the scene below. The square is bustling with people engaging in various activities, and a statue is at the center. Elegant buildings with arches and domes form the horizon, serving as a backdrop. The artwork features intricate line work, possibly created with pen or etching techniques, and a monochrome color palette with a sepia tone. The detailed scene conveys a sense of historical vitality and architectural grandeur.

artworks.title: Fireworks on the Arno, Florence
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's eye view of a public square with various activities happening. The horizon is high in the composition, displaying a wide landscape with an urban setting in the distance. The horizon line showcases structures like domes and city buildings, suggesting a bustling city life. The scene is depicted in a linear style with fine line work typical of etching, detailing figures and architectural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing brown and sepia tones for an aged effect. People are engaging in activities near the bottom, including walking, riding horses, and pulling carts. In the distance, there is a fountain or fireworks display as a focal point, with a cityscape and bridge framing the scene.
